full_name: Irene Maxine Pepperberg | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2004–2005 Social Sciences Bunting Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Brandeis University
bio: Irene Maxine Pepperberg, currently a research associate professor at Brandeis University, studies the cognitive and communicative abilities of grey parrots.
